settings.title: Rewrite your product copy with AI
settings.body: The job walks the catalog, finds products whose description or bullets are missing or short, and rewrites them through your store's AI provider. One product per step — safe to stop and resume. Configure the style in the settings panel below.

jobs.name: Generate product copy
jobs.description: Rewrites descriptions and bullet points through the store's AI provider, one product per step.

configSchema.label: Writing instructions
configSchema.description: Optional. Your voice/tone rules; the product data is appended automatically.

configSchema.label: Only products missing copy
configSchema.description: On = skip products that already have a description and bullets. Off = rewrite everything.

configSchema.label: Max products (0 = all)
configSchema.description: Stop after this many products. Useful for a first run.

configSchema.label: Bullet points per product
configSchema.description: How many bullet points the model should write.
